steps.en: A daily job builds the 2nd letter file for the vendor
steps.id: Job harian membuat file surat kedua untuk vendor
steps.why_en: Daily letter run is switched off in code; letters only go out when triggered by hand
steps.why_id: Job surat harian dimatikan di code; surat hanya keluar kalau dipicu manual

steps.en: Notices entitled to the 2nd letter are selected
steps.id: Notice yang berhak mendapat surat kedua dipilih

steps.en: The letter goes to the latest address and notices without one are skipped
steps.id: Surat dikirim ke alamat terbaru dan notice tanpa alamat dilewati

steps.en: A data file with the letter details is created for the vendor to print
steps.id: File data berisi detail surat dibuat agar vendor mencetaknya

steps.en: The file is stored and encrypted before sending to the vendor
steps.id: File disimpan dan dienkripsi sebelum dikirim ke vendor

steps.en: The file is sent to the printing vendor
steps.why_en: Sending to the vendor is blocked by a setting in every environment.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman ke vendor diblok oleh pengaturan di semua environment.

steps.en: After sending, the notice moves on and is recorded as letter sent
steps.id: Setelah terkirim, notice maju dan dicatat sudah dikirimi surat
steps.why_en: The notice moves on even when the file was not actually delivered.
steps.why_id: Notice tetap maju walau file sebenarnya belum terkirim.
